PLAN "3-Week Powerlifting Peak"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak for powerlifting meet — maximal expression of squat, bench, deadlift"

PHASES
  PHASE "Week 1 — Volume Reduction" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Squat Focus — Heavy":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 300 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m

      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Bench Focus — Heavy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 300 seconds
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m

      DAY Thursday training 75m "Deadlift Focus — Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 5x2 rpe 8 rest 360 seconds
          front_squat 3x4 rpe 7 rest 240 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          good_morning 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m

      DAY Friday training 60m "Bench Variation — Moderate":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x3 rpe 7 rest 300 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m

  PHASE "Week 2 — Intensity Hold, Volume Drop" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Squat — Competition Intensity":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x2 rpe 8..9 rest 360 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x5 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x45 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m

      DAY Tuesday training 55m "Bench — Competition Intensity":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x2 rpe 8..9 rest 360 seconds
          incline_press 2x5 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m

      DAY Thursday training 65m "Deadlift — Competition Intensity":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x1..2 rpe 8..9 rest 420 seconds
          bent_over_row 2x6 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          good_morning 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m

      DAY Friday training 45m "Bench — Opener Feel":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 7..8 rest 300 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m

  PHASE "Week 3 — Final Taper, Meet Ready" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Squat — Opener Activation":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 7 rest 360 seconds
          leg_press 2x5 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds

          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds

      DAY Friday training 25m "Final Flush — Movement Only":
